name: git_branch
description: Create a new branch at the current HEAD in the workspace repository. Fails if a branch with that name already exists; it never force-creates or moves an existing branch.

detailed: Creates a branch at the current HEAD.
whimsical: Grow a new limb off the trunk.
{source} is forging a fork in the road

detailed: tool {participantRole} is creating a git branch

name.description: Name of the branch to create at the current HEAD. Must be a valid git branch name.

timeoutSeconds.description: Optional timeout in seconds. Capped by the executor default tool timeout; a value above the cap is clamped to the cap.
